name: Q1_daily_totals
request_body: SELECT date, count FROM pypi.pypi_downloads_per_day WHERE project = 'litellm' AND date >= '2026-03-17' ORDER BY date

name: Q2_daily_by_version_oct_nov
request_body: SELECT date, version, sum(count) AS count FROM pypi.pypi_downloads_per_day_by_version WHERE project = 'litellm' AND date >= '2026-10-01' AND version LIKE '1.10_.%' GROUP BY date, version ORDER BY date, version

name: Q3_daily_by_version_march
request_body: SELECT date, version, sum(count) AS count FROM pypi.pypi_downloads_per_day_by_version WHERE project = 'litellm' AND date BETWEEN '2026-03-17' AND '2026-04-30' AND version IN ('1.82.6', '1.82.7', '1.82.8', '1.82.9') GROUP BY date, version ORDER BY date, version
